ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "Sport and Diversity: Protest? Inclusion? Recognition?" This course examines questions related to diversity, equality, and sport participation in Post-WW II America. We will organize our readings and discussions around three areas: Sport, race, and globalization; sport, gender, and legislation; and sport, disability, and social movements. Topics we will cover include: Americaøs Goodwill Projects and Race; Racial Protest at the 1968 Olympics; Tiger Woods and Multi-culturalism; Gender Ideals and Sport; Title IX; the Gay Games; Disability, Sport, and Prosthetics, and the Americans with Disability Act and Sport Participation. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. Students who enroll in more than one may be dropped from the additional Discovery courses. For course descriptions, see the Discovery Program booklet.
